title: Rooftop units with deviations
summary: A rooftop unit submittal for Section 23 74 13 with a prohibited refrigerant and an efficiency below the specified IEER.

input.submittalText:
SUBMITTAL 23 74 13-01 - Packaged Rooftop Units RTU-1 to RTU-3
Mechanical contractor: Front Range Mechanical. Manufacturer: Lennox Energence.

Model LGH180H4: nominal 15-ton cooling, gas heat 240 MBH input.
Efficiency: IEER 13.2, EER 11.0.
Refrigerant: R-410A.
Economizer: dry-bulb economizer with fault detection and diagnostics (FDD).
Supply fan: direct-drive EC motor, variable speed.
Electrical: 460V/3ph/60Hz, single-point power with factory-installed disconnect.
Warranty: 5 years compressor, 1 year parts.
Sound data and curb details attached.
